text:
Maria: quick ask — can someone run a small SKU compare (A100 / H100 / L40S) for the gpt-like runtime we're shipping? want p95/p99 latency + cost-per-1k-tokens numbers. seq=1024, batches=1 and 8. low-effort: fp16 and int8 runs. target: regressions check vs last month's numbers. cc @Raj @Devon :eyes:

Maria: example command I'd run locally (feel free to adapt):
```
./tools/bench-run \--model rdx/gpt-10b \--seq 1024 \--batch 1 \--hw A100 \--quant fp16 \--profile p95,p99 \--tokens 10000 \--warmup 50
```

Raj: can do. couple questions: 1) do you want cold-start (KV empty) or warm cache? 2) price points to use for cost calc (on-demand list or our internal discounted rates)?

Maria: thanks — prefer warm cache for p95/p99 realistic app latency, but please also include a single cold-start run. use our committed price table (internal rates) — I think infra has the latest.

Devon: I'll run batch=1 and 8, warm+cold for each hw/quant. quick note: make sure to pin the same kernel set and disable auto-fallback so results are comparable. use `--disable-fallback` and `--fixed-kernels` flags. also log the nv-peer-to-peer stats (we had a weird host->device memcpy last run).

Taylor: add perf counters too if you can: `nvidia-smi dmon` + `nvprof` for hotspots. for cost, we should compute: cost_per_1k = (avg_runtime_sec_per_token * tokens * price_per_gpu_per_sec) normalized to 1k tokens. i'll paste our price table in a sec. :+1:

infra-bot: benchmark job scheduled: job_id=bench-2026-03-17-77, queue=priority, owner=Devon. ETA ~40m. See /bench/logs/bench-2026-03-17-77.log when done.

Raj: quick sanity note — for L40S we should run with ECC off and power capping disabled (matches cloud profile). i'll include the exact hw config in the log. also will collect kernel-level timelines.

Devon: started A100 fp16 batch=1 warm run. command used:
```
./tools/bench-run \--model rdx/gpt-10b \--seq 1024 \--batch 1 \--hw A100 \--quant fp16 \--profile p95,p99 \--warmup 50 \--disable-fallback \--fixed-kernels \--dump-trace /tmp/trace-a100-fp16-b1.json
```

Devon: update — A100 fp16 batch=1 warm: p95=74ms, p99=128ms, avg=48ms. tokens processed=10k. raw runtime=~480s. attaching small summary in thread (logs -> /bench/logs/bench-2026-03-17-77-a100-fp16.txt). :white_check_mark:

Taylor: nice. can you also run H100 same config and drop me the `nvprof --events` output? I want to compare SM utilization and l2 hit rates.

Devon: running H100 now. will also do int8. fps: expecting lower p95 but watch memory-bandwidth on L40S.

infra-bot: job update: bench-2026-03-17-77 -> H100 fp16 completed, logs at /bench/logs/bench-2026-03-17-77-h100-fp16.txt

Devon: H100 fp16 batch=1 warm: p95=63ms, p99=110ms, avg=40ms. cold-start p95 ~ 210ms for first token. int8 (H100) batch=1 warm: p95=58ms, p99=98ms. notes: obvious perf win on H100 for int8.

Raj: L40S run queued. reminder: L40S price_per_hour we use = $2.40/hr (internal committed). A100 = $3.10/hr, H100 = $4.80/hr. Taylor: use those for cost calc.

Devon: L40S fp16 batch=1 warm: p95=85ms, p99=150ms. int8 not stable on our current kernel set, need quant-fix patch; filed issue #4321.

Maria: awesome, thanks team. two asks: 1) can someone paste a short table with p95/p99 + cost_per_1k (using Raj's prices) for all runs (batch=1) in this thread? 2) open a follow-up to validate int8 on L40S before next canary if it's required.

Raj: quick table (batch=1, warm, tokens normalized to 1k):
- A100 fp16: p95=74ms, p99=128ms, cost/1k=$0.065
- H100 fp16: p95=63ms, p99=110ms, cost/1k=$0.125
- H100 int8: p95=58ms, p99=98ms, cost/1k=$0.116
- L40S fp16: p95=85ms, p99=150ms, cost/1k=$0.036
(note: cost calc used price_per_sec = price_per_hour/3600 and runtime_sec = p95/1000 * tokens; round-trip simplification)

Devon: filing follow-up: INT8-L40S stability -> issue #4321 (assign: @infra-team). also added benchmark artifacts to: /bench/artifacts/2026-03-17/bench-2026-03-17-77.tar.gz

Taylor: thanks — i'll update the perf dashboard with these numbers and add p99 traces. tagging eng-sre for visibility. :eyes:

Maria: perfect. this is enough for the regression check. if no one objects i'll mark this as 'ok to promote' for the canary config (but block L40S int8 until #4321 is fixed). :thumbsup:

Devon: +1 from me.

Raj: +1.

infra-bot: thread closed for bench-2026-03-17-77, summary saved to /bench/summaries/2026-03-17-77-summary.json.
